market.question: Will London have between 10-15mm of precipitation in May?

assessment.reasoning: Heathrow May rainfall climatology averages ~45-50mm; 10-15mm bracket would require an exceptionally dry month (well below climatological 10th percentile). Long-range outlooks don't indicate such anomalous dryness. Low probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Persistent high-pressure block could deliver an exceptionally dry month.
